summary: B&R Technology Merger Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its $325 million IPO (32.5 million units at $10.00 each), with an underwriter over-allotment option for up to 4.875 million additional units. Simultaneously, the sponsor purchased 687,500 private placement units at $10.00, raising $6.875 million. Proceeds of $325 million ($10.00 per unit) were deposited into a U.S. trust account with Continental Stock Transfer Trust Company, including up to $13 million of deferred underwriter discount. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a warrant exercisable at $11.50. What to watch: SPAC merger target announcement within 24 months; risk-arb centers on trust value and redemption dynamics.
